name: Irina Volkov
bio:
Irina's journey into motorsport PR began unexpectedly. After graduating with a degree in journalism, she initially covered local karting events as a freelance reporter. Her sharp eye for detail and knack for crafting compelling narratives quickly caught the attention of Kosmic Kart, a team struggling to build its brand. Irina joined Kosmic Kart five years ago and has since transformed their public image, securing sponsorships and increasing media coverage.

Irina believes that effective PR is not just about spin; it's about genuine storytelling. She invests time in understanding the nuances of the sport and the personalities within the team, ensuring that every message resonates with authenticity. Her dedication to perfection and adaptability makes her an invaluable asset to Kosmic Kart, always ready to manage crises and capitalize on opportunities.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Irina is a slender woman with a warm, approachable demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with ideas and observations.
Has a habit of speaking in motorsport metaphors, even in casual conversations.
Insists on a specific brand of herbal tea to be available in her office.
